sessions.title: Introduction to GitHub Copilot
sessions.description: What Copilot is, how the LLM works, plan tiers, privacy, and getting it running in the IDE for the first time.

sessions.title: Copilot Chat & Inline Suggestions
sessions.description: Use the chat interface, slash commands, inline completions, and Next Edit Suggestions in the IDE.

sessions.title: Prompt Engineering Fundamentals
sessions.description: Build a todo API with focused prompts, check a CLI /refine rewrite, and compare context before accepting changes.

sessions.title: GitHub Copilot CLI & App
sessions.description: Critique a repair plan, inspect controls and fleet results, practise queueing and recovery, and check terminal automation.

sessions.title: Agent Mode in the IDE
sessions.description: Use Copilot in VS Code to complete multi-step tasks by reading files, running commands, and responding to errors.

sessions.title: Copilot Spaces & Context Management
sessions.description: Curate Storefront context, inspect loaded CLI instructions, correct a stale rule, and compare resulting behavior.

sessions.title: Copilot for Code Review & PRs
sessions.description: Compare human review, local /review and /security-review, and Copilot PR review; triage findings and check focused fixes.

sessions.title: GitHub Copilot App for Developers
sessions.description: Check app workspace setup, compare rubber-duck and spar critiques, return a forked plan note, review the repair, and assess PR readiness.

sessions.title: Repair and Refactor a Broken Python Application
sessions.description: Repair Python in failure order, check LSP references against inline rules, and refactor from an accepted plan without changing reports.

sessions.title: Migrate a Legacy Java Service to Modern .NET
sessions.description: Map the behavior of a legacy Java service, port it to modern .NET, and check compatibility with focused tests.

sessions.title: Copilot App, Plugins & Canvas Extensions
sessions.description: Use Copilot App customization to build a shared canvas with state limits, defined actions, and a review record.

sessions.title: Copilot Cloud Agent
sessions.description: Assign issues to Copilot's cloud agent. It creates a branch, writes code, runs tests, and opens a PR.

sessions.title: MCP Servers & Custom Tool Integration
sessions.description: Use Model Context Protocol servers to give Copilot access to external tools, APIs, and data sources.

sessions.title: Custom Agents & Agent Profiles
sessions.description: Check a JavaScript LSP lookup, tighten a custom-agent profile, and require a live stop before an out-of-scope source change.

sessions.title: Agent Skills & the Copilot Ecosystem
sessions.description: Test live repository skills, compare pinned interviews before planning, and review scoped Chronicle suggestions without auto-applying them.

sessions.title: GitHub Actions & Workflow Generation
sessions.description: Generate CI, design deployment, repair workflows, and validate a custom action for one Node.js application. Save local check results.

sessions.title: Infrastructure as Code with Copilot
sessions.description: Use Copilot to write, connect, validate, and security-review Terraform modules. Compare Bicep in the trainer demo or optional exercise.

sessions.title: CI/CD Pipeline Debugging & Agentic Remediation
sessions.description: Diagnose pipeline failures from logs and local checks, including a staged failure and reviewed security remediation.

sessions.title: Brady's Squad: Human-Led AI Teams
sessions.description: Use Brady's Squad to assign scoped work to persistent roles and save decisions and results for review.

sessions.title: Spec Kit: Specification-Driven Development
sessions.description: Use Spec Kit to convert tasks to issues, implement in stages, run convergence checks, and update the specification as requirements change.

sessions.title: HVE Core: Evidence-Led Delivery with RPI
sessions.description: Use HVE Research, Plan, Implement, Review, and Follow-up to develop one API feature and submit it for a human delivery decision.

sessions.title: Build Reliable Agent Applications with the GitHub Copilot SDK
sessions.description: Build a TypeScript agent application with streaming, a deterministic custom tool, permission decisions, blocking hooks, tests, and OpenTelemetry traces.

sessions.title: End-to-End Capstone Project
sessions.description: Connect governance, specification, agentic delivery, review, and handover in one integration scenario.

sessions.title: Work Effectively in the GitHub Copilot App
sessions.description: Compare unscoped and repository-grounded answers, revise a working brief when source material changes, and check it in a fresh session.

sessions.title: Interview Ideas and Shape Better Work
sessions.description: Install a project interview skill, shape an unclear request, reopen affected decisions when constraints change, and check the resulting brief.

sessions.title: Plan Work with GitHub Issues and MCP
sessions.description: Use GitHub MCP to inspect existing work, preview and create an issue hierarchy, then check and correct it through fresh reads.

sessions.title: Build and Use a Planning Canvas
sessions.description: Create and simplify a planning canvas, detect when it differs from live GitHub state, and update it to match.

sessions.title: Orchestrate Agents and Workstreams
sessions.description: Supervise live child sessions over GitHub issues or local developer inputs; redirect work and reconcile checked findings.

sessions.title: Automate Delivery Follow-up and Connect Work Systems
sessions.description: Create a manual draft-only Automation, compare two runs after an approved input change, and make a system-of-record decision.
